summary: Edit and finish video with tools for cutting, color grading, visual effects, and audio post-production. Available in a free edition and the paid Resolve Studio edition.
overview: Resolve brings the main stages of video production into one application, from assembling clips on a timeline to grading the image and finishing the soundtrack. Fusion provides tools for effects and compositing, while Fairlight handles audio work. This makes it possible to develop a project through several stages without moving everything between separate editing, effects, and audio applications.
